HostGPO | Full-time | Remote | $200,000 - $240,000 / yr + equity

We’re looking for a Lead Engineer to help shape the future of HostGPO’s platform, data systems, and technical direction. This person will be a senior builder and technical leader - someone who can architect and ship scalable systems, navigate messy real-world business logic, and partner across the organization to solve problems.

- Strong full-stack fluency, with particular preference for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React - Experience building and scaling backend systems, APIs, data platforms, and large-scale web applications - Experience with GraphQL and modern application architecture

Apply here on LinkedIn: https://lnkd.in/ezEQr_FX
